dm.summary:
At the start, seat.js could not reach the dm browser because the machine had restarted, so I ran start_all.sh once. That reloaded my desk; I did not reload it myself. After that the desk showed all four join requests (Cass, Bram, Pontius, Dev) and no console errors.

I opened each sheet with View sheet, checked it against the creation rules in the source, and approved it from the sheet. Each approval went back to the roster with the next request showing. It added the roster card and an Activity Log line, and that investigator appeared in the Circle formation panel right away. No one was told to press Check.

While reviewing, I found and logged F021: a drive whose maximum is 0 shows as '0 of 1 available' with an empty pip. The cause is the `or 1` in serializers.py. It affects Robert's Pontius (Nerve) and Dev (Nerve).

There is no 'start circle formation' button. The formation papers open on their own on each approved player's desk as a modal, and they have no close button until the circle is sealed. My Roster shows the progress in 'Circle formation so far'.

I pressed Finalize the circle once to read its warning, then pressed 'Not yet'. The circle is NOT finalized. I logged the warning as praise (F023) and the approve-from-sheet flow as praise (F022). I welcomed each investigator at the table and told the table what happens next. Memory is updated in /home/user/pt3/memory/dm.md.
dm.for_players:
1. Open The Saltmere Chapter desk from your hub. You are approved, and the hub should notice by itself. The 'Circle Formation Papers' open on top of your desk.
2. I. Circle Question: tap the question you want to vote for. Under the leading question, write Your Personal Answer. It saves when you click or tap away, and you will see 'Saved'.
3. II. Name the Circle: type a name and press Suggest (up to 5 each). Then press Vote on the suggested name you like best.
4. III. Chapter House: write where the circle meets in the shared box, or tap one of the Examples. The box is shared: whatever is saved last replaces what was there. It saves when you click away.
5. IV. Circle Ability: tap one ability to vote for it.
6. V. Insignia: tap one insignia to vote for it.
7. VI. Circle Relationships: for each other investigator, press 'Propose a relationship', choose a type, write your answer and press 'Propose to <name>'. When someone proposes to you, press Accept, or press Counter and then 'Send counter'.
8. Say at the table when you are done. The papers stay open until the Lightkeeper seals the circle, then they close for everyone.
dm.for_robert: Pontius is approved. The Circle Formation Papers should be open on your Saltmere desk without your having to press Check. In the papers, vote a circle question and write your personal answer, suggest and vote a name, write or pick the chapter house, vote an ability and an insignia, and propose a relationship to Cass, Bram and Dev (and accept or counter theirs). Tell the table when you are done; I seal the circle once every part has a choice.

prompts.bram: Fill in all six parts of the Circle Formation Papers on your phone (use the I-VI buttons at the top to jump between parts), propose a relationship to each of the others, and say at the table when you are done.
prompts.cass: Fill in all six parts of the Circle Formation Papers, propose relationships to Bram, Dev and Pontius, and answer theirs. You may try edge cases in the shared Chapter House box (it is last save wins). Say at the table when you are done.
prompts.dev: Fill in all six parts of the Circle Formation Papers. Write a real personal answer and the chapter house, and propose story-rich relationships to Cass, Bram and Pontius. Say at the table when you are done.
